formal_scope: The exact hypotheses, mathematical claims, indexing translations and limitations are given row by row in LEAN_CORRESPONDENCE.json and its text rendering.
classical_input: EdreiPolynomialInput remains an explicit input to the full TN/negative-root characterization. The BTP iff PBF construction does not assume that input.
relative_scope: Entrywise relative perturbations in arbitrary finite bandwidth; no common-domain assertion for closed unbounded operators is made.
not_formalized: Interior implies analytic LDU, local-family dimension, perturbation examples and several stability corollaries are not claimed by the general-criterion formalization.
The Jacobi-fraction formulation and the polynomial, spectral, measure and asymptotic results are not formalized.
The Wall–Chihara identification following Proposition 2.23 is explained algebraically in the manuscript.
lean_build_provenance: All 188 listed modules were rebuilt from source in four fresh project directories. The transitive axiom audits passed for all 5346 theorem checks across the projects. All 52 declaration references in the 18-row manuscript correspondence were matched to the new audit logs.
count_explanation: 188 listed local modules, four axiom-audit modules and one pinned Mathlib source exception are included. Shared source modules are counted in each standalone project; these are not counts of distinct mathematical results.
auxiliary_modules: Complete standalone projects are preserved. Auxiliary periodic and quantitative-radius modules do not add rows or claims to the current correspondence table.
source_preservation: All mathematical declarations were preserved. Nine Lean source headers were edited to refer to the manuscript by theorem labels. These exact source files were recompiled and audited.
computations: Recorded checks and their execution dates appear in computations/RECORDED_CHECKS.json. The boundary-residue check was rerun after editing its docstring.
